headline: Pakistan KSE-100 Index Gains Over 1,200 Points in Morning Session
summary: Buying in commercial banks, fertilizer, and energy stocks propelled the Pakistan Stock Exchange's KSE-100 Index up 1,231 points, or 0.69%, to 178,705.34 at open.
why: The KSE-100 Index is the primary equity benchmark tracking Pakistan's top capitalised companies.

impacts.name: KSE-100
impacts.why: Broad buying across key sectors lifted the benchmark index.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investor sentiment was boosted by selective buying across commercial banking and energy constituents.
